summary: My Workspace: the doctor's schedule and the clinical panel of the patient they're seeing.
purpose: For the doctor: see their appointments for the day (or a period or calendar), pick the patient and, without leaving, review alerts, record, sessions and odontogram, complete the clinical session, prescribe and ask the AI clinical agent.
tips: The schedule refreshes every minute on its own and lets you know when an appointment comes in, changes, is rescheduled or reassigned to you.
There's only one clinical session per patient per day, and it's completed from the day of the appointment.
When the clinical session is saved, the appointment becomes Completed.
In «My calendars» you see a room's appointments even if they're not yours.

workspace.section.agenda.label: Today's schedule
workspace.section.agenda.description: The doctor's appointments in time order.

workspace.filter.date.label: Day or period
workspace.filter.date.description: Today, tomorrow, this week, next 7 days, this month, next month, last month or a day/period on the calendar.

workspace.tab.assigned.label: Assigned to me
workspace.tab.assigned.description: The appointments where you're the doctor.

workspace.tab.calendars.label: My calendars
workspace.tab.calendars.description: The appointments of a room you have access to.

workspace.section.appointments.label: Appointments
workspace.section.appointments.description: Tap one to open the patient panel.

workspace.section.timeline.label: Timeline
workspace.section.timeline.description: Previous sessions; the most recent one open.

workspace.btn.session.label: Complete clinical session
workspace.btn.session.description: One per patient per day, from the day of the appointment. When saved, the appointment becomes Completed.

workspace.btn.lab-order.label: Lab order
workspace.btn.lab-order.description: Creates a lab order for the appointment's patient with the doctor already selected (only users who can edit orders can change it). When you save a session with lab services, the order opens on its own, already filled in.

workspace.field.session-treatments.label: Treatments
workspace.field.session-treatments.description: Those from the quote that were done today.

workspace.btn.submit.label: Save
workspace.btn.submit.description: Save the clinical session or the prescription.

workspace.section.odontogram-dictation.label: Dictate findings
workspace.section.odontogram-dictation.description: Bar to dictate or type what you see (“caries OM en 16, corona indicada en 14”). Invoke proposes it on the teeth and nothing is recorded until you confirm.

workspace.field.odontogram-dictation.label: Dictated text
workspace.field.odontogram-dictation.description: Tooth, condition, surfaces and status: “indicada”, “existente” or “hoy”. Accepts ranges for bridges (“del 24 al 26”).

workspace.btn.odontogram-propose.label: Propose
workspace.btn.odontogram-propose.description: Turns the text into dashed proposals on the teeth; anything already recorded is dropped automatically.

workspace.btn.odontogram-confirm-proposa.label: Confirm all
workspace.btn.odontogram-confirm-proposa.description: Records every proposal of the tray on the odontogram. “Discard” removes them without saving anything.

workspace.section.odontogram-inspector.label: Tooth inspector
workspace.section.odontogram-inspector.description: With a tooth selected: its surfaces, how to record, the conditions and what it already has (change a mark's status from its menu). With no tooth, the conditions to activate and the state of the whole mouth.

workspace.field.odontogram-record-as.label: Record as
workspace.field.odontogram-record-as.description: Indicated (red, to do), Existing (blue, already there) or Done today (green, done in this session). Sets the color and status of what you mark.

workspace.section.odontogram-tiles.label: Frequent conditions
workspace.section.odontogram-tiles.description: Tapping a condition makes it active: every tooth or surface you tap on the odontogram gets it, until you release it with Esc or by tapping it again. If a tooth was already selected, it is recorded there too.

workspace.field.odontogram-search.label: Search condition
workspace.field.odontogram-search.description: The whole condition catalog, by name or code, filtered by category.

workspace.btn.aesthetic.label: Aesthetic session
workspace.btn.aesthetic.description: Opens the aesthetic session linked to this appointment and its doctor.
